rendering: Rendered during the run by app/compose_seaside.py, which synthesizes every part in NumPy (additive and phase-modulated tones and synthetic drums, with no samples or sound banks), adds stereo early reflections and a 1.2 s fade, and writes a 44.1 kHz 16-bit stereo WAV. A separate step not included in the script converted the WAV to a 192 kbps CBR MP3 with FFmpeg 6.1. Its audio matches the WAV after FFmpeg's loudnorm filter at I=-18 LUFS and LRA=11. Nothing was rendered, normalized, mixed, or edited after the run.
